clock: All timestamps use original video seconds and must align with HudObservation.time_sec.

passes.purpose: Broad state/entity/minimap/location tracking. Never sufficient alone for micro mechanics.

Always-on low-cost trigger scan while live_first_person: ammo_current/delta request, cheap recoil/muzzle score, enemy appearance, minimap displacement, location changes. This pass is the guaranteed source that can open Pass C.
Refine burst-start/first-shot, stopping, peek and engagement candidates in short windows. Do not attempt exact per-bullet counting for full-auto fire.
passes.activation: Opened by Pass B/HUD ammo delta, cheap recoil/muzzle score, enemy appearance, sharp motion/cover transition, utility cast, or engagement transition.

passes.purpose: Optional ±0.35 s burst only for first-shot/stop timing when Pass C is insufficient. Never used to count every bullet in full-auto fire.
passes.activation: Only for unresolved AIM-03/MOV-02 timing and within cost budget.

constraints: Do not decode the entire match at 60 fps for semantic analysis.
Do not run semantic VLM on every frame; use selected keyframes/candidate sequences only.
Frames with HUD primary_state other than live_first_person are ineligible for target-player aim/movement/peek mechanics.
Semantic call budgets are enforced per round and per match; budget exhaustion returns unknown/null rather than extra calls.
Homography/back-projection preaim analysis is not an MVP path.

cross_module_trigger_contract.ammo_monitoring: While live_first_person, scheduler requests HUD ammo_current at >=5 fps or reuses the same HUD ROI reader at Pass B cadence. Ammo decrease is a burst/shot trigger; ammo increase must be classified as reload/switch/purchase before shot logic.
cross_module_trigger_contract.redundant_visual_trigger: Pass B also computes cheap muzzle/recoil scores so Pass C can open even if a HUD ammo sample is missed.
cross_module_trigger_contract.shot_event_granularity: MVP emits a shot event at trigger/burst start (especially first_shot). It does not guarantee one event per bullet during automatic fire.
